title: Ekelle commands respect with bold new soundtrack “Kiss the Ring”
htmlContent: Ekelle starts the year strong with her new song, "Kiss the Ring." This track is all about self worth, ambition, and confidently being yourself. It's the first of many singles she plans to release in 2025. Signed to Cymba Music Publishing, Ekelle is known for her powerful rap style and sharp lyrics, and "Kiss the Ring" is no different. The beat feels intense and commanding, and her words cut through the noise, signifying that respect is something you earn, not something you ask for. This song is for hard workers, the ones pushing through difficulties and ready to claim their success. The production perfectly mixes raw energy with smooth execution, featuring strong beats. https://open.spotify.com/track/4mQNO7gea2oEmxhEsACmHR?si=O1x5Uf8wQp-23pj4smdgQA Every verse feels purposeful, like a call to action for those who believe in themselves and aim for more. It's a song for anyone who has struggled to find their place, turning challenges into opportunities. Ekelle represents a whole generation of determined individuals who refuse to give up. Ekelle is stepping up and claiming what's rightfully hers. Follow on: Facebook/Instagram/TikTok
